limits: Records the author's answers; it does not check the paper.
Digital PCR is dMIQE 2020's checklist, not this one.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Lays the author's own answers against MIQE 2.0's published items; it computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which MIQE 2.0 items does a qPCR paper provide, and where, or why are they omitted?

description: The MIQE 2.0 checklist for a qPCR paper (Bustin et al. 2025, Clin Chem 71:634, Table 1): every item in its five sections, with your answers. Each answer is Provided (yes or no) and Description/Justification: where in the article when yes, why it is omitted when no; an answer missing that is named. Returns every row, the counts and a TSV under the paper's headers. Run with no answers to read the item ids. Digital PCR has its own checklist, dMIQE 2020.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

answers.description: answers by item id, e.g. {"5.8": {"provided": "yes", "description": "Results, Table 2: standard curve over five tenfold dilutions"}, "3.5": {"provided": "no", "description": "DNase-treated RNA validated DNA-free"}}. Ids run section.item over the paper's order (1 Reagent preparation · 2 Sample preparation · 3 Reverse transcription · 4 qPCR protocol · 5 Data analysis).

name: miqe_checklist

incomplete.description: answers without the location (yes) or reason (no) the checklist asks for

notes.description: the table's footnotes by letter, which qualify the items that carry them

reading.description: what is answered and what is still owed, generated from the answers

rows.description: one row per item, in the paper's order: section, id, item, footnotes, provided, description, and the gap footnote b would still send back

tsv.description: the checklist as tab-separated text under the paper's own column headers, for a journal submission
